en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone landscaped structure in a wooded park. The central feature is a semicircular masonry wall built from irregular stones, with two nested pointed arches forming a niche that appears to frame a spring or small fountain. In front is a circular or oval flowerbed edged with rocks, and tall trees fill the background. In the lower right corner, printed text identifies the location as Geithain i. Sa. Hellquelle.
